focus.title: 欧盟对华电动车反补贴税终裁落地，出海车企须重构供应链与定价策略
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会近日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查终裁，决定征收为期五年的最终反补贴税，税率因企业配合程度而异。中国车企面临整车出口成本上升、欧盟本地化生产压力加大等挑战。实务上，企业应尽快评估关税对现有贸易模式的影响，考虑通过欧盟境内组装、技术授权或与当地伙伴合资等方式降低税负，同时完善原产地规则合规与供应链追溯体系，防范后续延伸调查风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会贸易救济公告 · 2026.11.03
focus.title_en: EU Imposes Final Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs: Supply Chain and Pricing Overhaul Required
focus.summary_en: The European Commission has published its final countervailing duty determination on Chinese electric vehicles, imposing five-year duties that vary by company cooperation level. Chinese automakers face higher export costs and mounting pressure to localize production in the EU. In practice, companies should promptly assess the tariff impact on existing trade models, explore EU-based assembly, technology licensing, or joint ventures with local partners to mitigate duty exposure, and strengthen origin-rule compliance and supply chain traceability to guard against follow-on investigations.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission Trade Remedy Notice · 2026.11.03

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭明确跨境仲裁中单方指定仲裁员条款效力，中企应审慎设计争议解决条款
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一起涉华贸易合同纠纷中，认定约定由一方单方指定仲裁员的条款违反自然正义原则，裁决不予执行。该案凸显跨境合同中仲裁条款设计的重要性。实务建议：中企在起草涉外合同时，应避免赋予单方指定仲裁员或控制仲裁程序的权利，优先选择双方共同指定或由机构指定的机制，并明确仲裁地、仲裁规则与语言，以降低裁决被撤销或不予执行的风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判决摘要 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Clarifies Validity of Unilateral Arbitrator Appointment Clauses in Cross-Border Arbitration
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently ruled in a China-related trade contract dispute that a clause allowing one party to unilaterally appoint the arbitrator violated natural justice, and refused enforcement of the award. The case underscores the importance of drafting arbitration clauses in cross-border contracts. Practical advice: Chinese companies should avoid granting one party the right to unilaterally appoint arbitrators or control proceedings, prefer mutual or institutional appointment mechanisms, and specify the seat, rules, and language of arbitration to reduce the risk of awards being set aside or denied enforcement.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal Judgment Summary · 2026.10

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩展，企业须完善数据出境合规路径
policy.summary: 广东省网信办等部门近期扩大粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化试点范围，允许符合条件的企业在备案后向港澳传输特定商业数据。此举有助于降低跨境数据合规成本，但企业仍需履行个人信息保护影响评估、合同备案等义务。实务上，建议企业梳理数据出境场景，优先适用试点便利化通道，同时建立数据分类分级与安全评估机制，确保符合《个人信息保护法》及港澳相关法规要求。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation: Compliance Pathways for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: Guangdong's cyberspace authorities and other departments recently expanded the pilot for facilitating cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, allowing eligible enterprises to transfer specified commercial data to Hong Kong and Macao after filing. This helps reduce compliance costs but enterprises must still conduct personal information protection impact assessments and file contracts. In practice, companies should map data export scenarios, prioritize the pilot facilitation channel, and establish data classification and security assessment mechanisms to comply with the Personal Information Protection Law and relevant Hong Kong and Macao regulations.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.10

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美对华半导体出口管制新规下，企业应建立动态合规与供应链尽职调查机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期进一步收紧对华半导体出口管制，扩大实体清单并限制先进计算芯片与制造设备对华出口，同时加强对第三国转口的管控。中国企业面临供应链中断与次级制裁风险。建议企业立即开展供应链穿透式排查，识别受控物项与交易对手，完善最终用户/最终用途声明，并在合同中加入出口管制合规承诺与终止条款。同时建立动态监测机制，跟踪美方规则更新，必要时申请许可或调整采购路径，以降低违规风险。
analysis.source: 来源：美国商务部工业与安全局公告 · 2026.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Under New US Semiconductor Export Controls, Enterprises Should Build Dynamic Compliance and Supply Chain Due Diligence
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US has recently further tightened semiconductor export controls on China, expanding the Entity List and restricting exports of advanced computing chips and manufacturing equipment, while strengthening controls on third-country transshipment. Chinese enterprises face supply chain disruption and secondary sanctions risks. Companies should immediately conduct penetrating supply chain reviews, identify controlled items and counterparties, improve end-user/end-use statements, and incorporate export control compliance commitments and termination clauses into contracts. They should also establish dynamic monitoring mechanisms to track US rule updates, apply for licenses where necessary, or adjust procurement routes to mitigate violation risks.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Bureau of Industry and Security Notice · 2026.10
